description: Search flight offers between an origin and destination, with pricing scaled by number of adults.

departure_date.description: Optional departure date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter offers.

adults.description: Number of adult travelers (default 1); scales the quoted price.

max_results.description: Maximum number of offers to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with meta, data (offers) and dictionaries (carriers, locations).

description: Confirm pricing for a flight offer; seeded offers use the authoritative seeded price.

offer.description: A flight-offer object; if it has a seeded id the seeded price is used, otherwise the posted price is echoed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with data (type, flightOffers); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Search reference-data locations (airports and/or cities) by keyword.

keyword.description: Optional keyword matched against IATA code, name, or city name.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with meta and a data list of location views.

description: Get a single reference-data location by its id (e.g. A-prefixed airport or C-prefixed city).

location_id.description: The location id, optionally prefixed with 'A' (airport) or 'C' (city).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a data location view; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get airline reference data, optionally filtered by IATA codes.

airline_codes.description: Optional comma-separated IATA airline codes to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with meta and a data list of airline objects.
